evidence_text: A developer community issue described a manual DevOps workflow pain.
A second independent buyer-oriented result described recurring manual data-entry pain.
A product-launch discussion promoted spreadsheet automation and was historically classified as seller launch content.

A routed community result was a disconfirming observation despite containing pain language.
